A lonely direwolf, wanders from her pack. She looks now for a place to die in peace. She is old, far older than most direwolves normally live, and has served her pack as matron for many moons. A gray forest surrounds her in the dark night, a full moon rising above her. As she wanders deeper still into these woods, the darkness grows deeper than she has ever known.

The shewolf carries on through the dark, the damp ground clinging now to her paws. Panic begins to take hold of the beast and she begins to run. Her breath mists in the cold night air. She frantically turns left, then right, then left again. Her eyes have grown wild, her mouth froths as if she were possessed. She runs until she collapses from exhaustion, then pulls herself, whimpering into the shadows of this hellish place. The ground beneath her parts, and begins to drag her down.

The wolf, she tries so hard to escape, but she can barely manage to whimper, whimper like she has not since she was a pup. She claws at the ground with the last of her strength, and as she is sucked beneath, she howls feebly at the sky. Her struggle leaves no trace upon the writhing ground; only the shadows know her pain. From the crevasse in which she disappeared, a shadow takes form.

The shadow floats freely in the moonlight. Holding form of its own will. It approaches a small pond and gazes into the water, only to discover that it casts no reflection. She chuckles to herself lightly.

Moons later, the shadow, who has [taken on a humanoid form and named herself Lillith](https://i.sli.mg/9ogjkT.jpg), draws a bear into the same woods where she was born. As the beast dies, tortured and alone, she forms the shadows around it, and by the time the ground has swallowed her prey, a new priestess is born. [Azazel](https://i.sli.mg/IlYU4c.jpg).

Not long after, a raven meets the same fate, pricking itself on a thorn of primrose in the woods, and the sisters name their new sister [Pandora](https://i.sli.mg/bwn4Wp.jpg).

Born of the stored magic of the Primrose Path, of the [magicks stored with Ouroboros body](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/777431), and the suffering of those unfortunate souls who wander onto the path unaided, the Night Wraiths now walk the world as beings both of Gaea and the Crossroads.
